about_the_game:
🦅 Only For Eagles🦅
The fortress looms high above the frozen peaks. Cable cars swing through stormy skies. Soldiers guard every ramp, every drop target, every path to the top. The mission? Impossible—unless you fly like an eagle.

🔥 Flamethrower Flippers – Burn through the battlefield with each precision strike.
🚡 Cable Car Ramps – Launch daring shots across deadly lifts that carry you closer to the castle gates.
💥 Drop Targets & Spinners – Smash enemy lines, unlock hidden passages, and trigger explosive sequences.
🦅 The Eagle’s Ascent – Only the sharpest, fastest, most fearless players can reach the fortress and claim victory.

Cinematic. Dramatic. Relentless. Only Four Eagles is more than pinball—it’s a spy-thriller mission brought to life on the playfield.

Because only an eagle can reach the castle.

short_description: Storm the mountain in a dystopian spy-thriller pinball. Hit the ramps, crush the drop targets, and reach the castle at the peak. pic cinematic pinball where ramps are cable cars, flippers are flamethrowers, and the fortress awaits—only an eagle can survive the climb
